In my case, instead of asking me to turn around, the masseuse (Kam) actually tapped/whacked me to signal it, which was quite surprising and unprofessional.

The gentleman at reception was polite, but the waiting area felt uncomfortable—there were too many men sitting around, which made the environment awkward. Women should be aware of this.
